THE BOX IS PORTRAIT AND ITS RATIO MOVES — MEASURED, NOT ASSUMED. Live DOM on the current page, image box (object-fit cover, object-position 50% 50%) at four widths:

  390  -> 350 x 508  (0.690)
  1024 -> 452 x 808  (0.559)
  1440 -> 660 x 802  (0.823)
  1920 -> 708 x 778  (0.911)

media_width is 50, so the width tracks the viewport while the height is set by the length of the text column beside it. 1024 is the extreme: a 452px column wraps that paragraph to 808px tall, giving the narrowest box on the page. Note this block is NOT square, unlike the key_findings blocks on /pages/copper-peptide-research — same lesson as key-findings-box-is-not-square-on-every-block: the ratio belongs to the text, not to the section type.

WHY THE SQUARE MASTER COULD NOT BE SHIPPED AS-IS. Every other image in this section is a square master and cover-crops harmlessly because they are textures. A face does not. Simulating the four box ratios against the untouched 2048x2048 square, the 0.559 box keeps only the middle 55.9% of the width and slices straight through the nostril — the profile ends in mid-nose and the hand is gone entirely. Checked as rendered crops, not by arithmetic.

CROP CHOSEN: x573-2048, full height, 1475x2048 = 0.720. Two candidates were rendered against all four box ratios and compared side by side (0.720 and 0.781). 0.781 still grazes the nose tip at the 0.559 box; 0.720 clears it, keeps the fingers in frame at every width down to 390, and at the widest box (0.911) gives up only 21% of the height, which is forehead and the underside of the jaw — neither is load-bearing. What is discarded on the left is 573px of out-of-focus hair and temple.

No re-compression below q95 and no long-edge cap needed: 1475x2048 is already inside the 3000px ceiling and the theme's srcset tops out at 800w here. Per the shopify-cdn-makes-source-compression-pointless lesson, the CDN is what a visitor downloads.

NEW FILENAME, not a re-upload over the old one: Shopify Files suffixes a name collision and keeps serving the original. The argireline texture file is left in place and simply stops being referenced by this block.

ALT TEXT describes what is in frame and does not claim a trial, a treatment or a result.
